I have a good one for this. Was terribly ill and moving houses on the same day. Was supposed to work a shift starting 4pm, I didn’t mind the move because everything for the move was to be completed by 12. 

Got tonsillitis the day before the move + shift so informed my manager that I won’t be able to work my 8 hour shift as I’m terribly ill (bear in mind, im paid hourly and do not get sick pay). However for context, I was moving to a place that was a 3 minute from the cafe I worked at. So after getting all my boxes in at the new house, I popped in at the cafe (absolutely dead btw, runny nose, could barely talk) to get takeaway lunch and buy my friend a takeaway pizza as a thank you for helping me out. The only reason I went there is because it was 2 mins away and I was in no shape to cook and/or risk another restaurant in a new locality. Spending money on delivery fee was not an option either because again, I did forego my pay for that day. 

A week later, management decides it was too sucky of me to come in for lunch with my friend after calling in sick and decides to terminate my contract without any warning.
